title: ELECTRICAL WIRING INSTALL
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEFENSE HEALTH AGENCY (DHA) > DEFENSE HEALTH AGENCY
description:
***Please read and adhere to the attachments in this RFQ. This requirement is a set aside for small business. 

 If there are any questions please contact Kimberly Bunn, Contract Specialist Naval Medical Center Portsmouth, VA via email Kimberly.p.bunn.civ@health.mil  

 No Phone calls regarding this solicitation will be taken only email. 

 
	 All interested vendors, for your bid to be considered submit a quote of your product with descriptions and or item part numbers for evaluation, along with an up-to-date SAMs registration. 
	 All interested vendors who submit a bid to the contact listed in this posting for your bid to be considered. 
	  It is not the responsibility of the Contract Specialist to follow up with what the vendor is missing upon submission. 
	 All interested vendors upon submission of an offer, invoices of at least 2 are required from either private or public institutions of these products. 
	 Refer to the Description/ Specifications/ Statement of work page for product information and salient characteristics of this RFQ for details concerning base access and requirements needed to fulfill solicitation. 
	 Only offers for   ALL   requirements will be considered. 
 

 ***This is an all or nothing solicitation, brand name or equal based on salient characteristics. 

 A one-time site-visit walk through of the spaces will be conducted on Friday November 20th, 2026 @ 12:30 PM EST All interested vendors are required to be present and participate in the scheduled site visit. Vendors not attending this scheduled one-time group site visit may be considered ineligible for contract award. Contractors interested in attending the site visit must notify the Contract Specialist, Kimberly Bunn via e-mail kimberly.p.bunn.civ@health.mil no later than 10:00am (Eastern Time) on Monday, 16th 2026 of your company's intentions to participate in the site visit walk-through. Only contractors who have notified the Contract Specialist will be allowed to participate in the site visit. Vendors' technical and pricing proposals are due by close of business on Tuesday, 24 June 2026.
